title: Croatian Cucumber and Tender Braised Delight
description: A refreshing summer dish featuring tender meat in a rich, herbal braise topped with crunchy cucumber.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add tender meat and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add herbal and Croatian seasonings, and pour in enough water to cover the meat.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
While the meat is cooking, slice the cucumber into thin rounds.
To serve, place a portion of the braised meat on a plate, top with sliced cucumber, and garnish with fresh herbs.
